name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Statesville NC

fieldNotes.location: 2203 Sherrill Dr, Statesville NC - confirmed via roster ROOFTOP geocode landing on the large distribution building, plus Dun & Bradstreet, Panjiva ('Gxo USA DC, 2203 Sherrill Drive') and GXO jobs site (active Statesville hiring). A large cross-dock DC in a wooded edge-of-town Iredell County industrial area; employee review notes the building is non-temperature-controlled.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A sliding/swing chain-link gate spans the truck lane entering the fenced dock/truck yard, visible in 2019/2022 Street View along the south dock face. The dock yard is fully chain-link-fenced. Classified true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth (no 1-3 vehicle-footprint structure) at the gate. Only a small post / call-box-style fixture beside the gate. guardShack false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present but no guard booth - implies kiosk / call-box / remote check-in. remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: The driveway approach and employee-parking apron outside the dock-yard gate provide paved room for trucks to stage before the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide, deep truck courts on both the north and south faces give ample internal staging before the docks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with dock banks on two opposite faces (north truck court and south truck court) - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors line both the north and south building faces. Estimated ~60 doors total for this ~495,000 SF building - 50+ band. Flagged uncertain (overhead count).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls run along the outer edge of both truck courts (north and south); ~12 trailers visible, capacity ~70. 10-25 band for trailers parked without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated striped trailer-parking stalls in both truck courts.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck courts are long and deep, holding well over 3 trucks in queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Statesville, surrounded by woods - small-town industrial; classified Rural per the rubric tiebreaker.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Wooded edge-of-town but still within the Statesville industrial area near other warehouses - cellular coverage likely adequate; recorded false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box yields ~28 acres for the fenced parcel including the building, truck courts, and employee parking.
